Scarf, ears, tail and four limbs require whole-body animation review.

region.finding: All 24 enlarged front/side head/body source/battle slices actually inspected across thirteen clips and six phases. White muzzle and blindfold mostly remain coherent visually, but the independently marked lower mouth rim has 21 non-head vertices, 5.53 mm relative movement and up to 4.2 percent edge stretch in head turns, attack, defeat and victory. Original unbrightened front head sheets and anatomy overlay inspected; patch belongs to the mouth above the separate scarf. Four legs, paws, torso, ears, scarf and curled tail remain connected. Separate candidate changes measured face influences with a smooth neck fade; requires independent anatomy, body conservation and actual visual review.

All 24 enlarged front/side head/body source/battle slices actually inspected across thirteen clips and six phases. Source lower beak and side cheek shift relative to the rigid forehead in head turns and recoil. Independent side jaw patch has 51 non-head vertices and 0.299 drift; anatomy overlay confirms cheek below the beak, above the separate chest feathers. Existing battle face is clean. Both wings, talons, headband ties and tail remain connected. Separate candidate changes measured face influences with a smooth neck fade; requires independent anatomy, body conservation and actual visual review.

All 24 enlarged front/side head/body source/battle slices actually inspected across thirteen clips and six phases. Lower muzzle and mouth stretch against the separate scarf in idle head turns, alternate idle, hit reaction and victory in both qualities. Corrected exposed chin and side cheek landmarks exclude rejected cloth picks. Eyes, large ears, four legs, body and flame tail remain coherent. Separate candidate changes measured face influences with a smooth neck fade; requires independent anatomy, body conservation and actual visual review.
